description: Validates one e-invoice file: XRechnung (UBL or CII), ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF, EN 16931 UBL/CII, Romanian e-Factura (CIUS-RO UBL) or Polish KSeF FA(3) XML. Reports errors and warnings with rule IDs such as BR-DE-15. The file is checked with the official validators (KoSIT, Mustang, CIUS-RO schematron, FA(3) XSD) and the format is detected automatically. Fits questions such as "validate this XRechnung", "is this invoice valid?", "why was it rejected?", whether a file exported from an ERP or invoicing software will pass validation, or whether a PDF contains structured invoice data. For CIUS-RO it adds Romanian pre-checks outside the schematron: CUI/CIF check digit, county code and IBAN checksum. Returns valid or invalid, the scenario, errors and warnings (explain_validation_rule explains each rule ID), validator versions and the SHA-256 of the input. A file that is not a recognised e-invoice is reported as not validated, with the reason. The document is processed in memory and not stored. Does not cover Peppol BIS rules, KSeF upload rules beyond the FA(3) schema, sending or filing invoices, or tax questions; a valid result is a technical check, not acceptance by a tax authority or recipient.

format.description: Default auto (detected from the file). cius-ro = Romanian e-Factura, zugferd = PDF, fa3 = Polish KSeF.

pdf_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD or Factur-X PDF (hybrid invoice with embedded XML), base64-encoded, at most 5 MB decoded. Use this or xml.

xml.description: The e-invoice XML as text: XRechnung, EN 16931 UBL/CII, Factur-X/ZUGFeRD XML, CIUS-RO (e-Factura) or KSeF FA(3); UTF-8, at most 2 MB. Use this or pdf_base64.

name: validate_einvoice
